text: PepsiCo's own Gatorade contact site describes the Gatorade Portfolio, which brings together Gatorade, Propel, Muscle Milk, Evolve and Fast Twitch, as a division of PepsiCo.
short: Gatorade is a division of PepsiCo.

source.name: PepsiCo (contact.pepsico.com) - Gatorade: About Us
source.quote: The Gatorade Portfolio, a division of PepsiCo (NASDAQ: PEP), is a connected performance and wellness ecosystem built to fuel all athletes and exercisers.
